revisionDesc.change: Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - lin15 leave space before .1 at the end

Submit - I corrected the unread last line 15 of the ed. pr. where in my opinion ἔλαττον (with apostrophe between double τ) can be clearly read. I initially thought the final ny could have been used as a line-filler, extending until the end of the line (ending in the still visible vertical stroke). Upon further reflection/discussion, this seems unlikely. One uncertain characted was added instead (perhaps the aroura-symbol?).

Vote - Return-Straight-to-Sender - This looks good, but I would feel happier with a little explanation of how the reading is made. ἔλαττον: the alpha has a rather long upstroke as well as a rather long downstroke which is connected to the cross stroke of the first tau. Is that an apostrophe separating the two taus? What is the rather long vertical stroke just to the right of the apostrophe. ον is then clear. Then there is space of one or two letters and above all what is that long vertical stroke at the end of the line. I think the maybe 2 or 3 underdots have to be placed at the end of the line.
Submit - submitted according to the edition
